button.name: Manage Attribute Types
button.button_desc: The Manage Attribute Type Wizard enables you to add additional attribute types to support splitting entities into different Satellites for the selected category.

button.name: Create Table
button.button_desc: Create a new table in the selected model.

button.name: Assign Attribute Types
button.button_desc: The Assign Attribute Type Wizard enables you to bulk assign attribute types across a model thus helping you to quickly mark up a model with the attribute type.

button.name: Add Source Mappings
button.button_desc: The Add Source Mappings wizard enables you to map a model onto another model by using exact name matching with case sensitive options.

button.name: Compare Models
button.button_desc: Compare the structure, business rules or profiling metrics for multiple models.

button.name: Merge Into Other Model
button.button_desc: It can often be useful to merge changes to a model into another model particularly when working in a repository or on a design imported from another modeling tool.

button.name: Generate Data Vault
button.button_desc: The Generating Data Vault wizard enables you to create a data vault from a data vault design model. After the wizard is run successfully, a data vault is generated.

button.name: Advanced Copy
button.button_desc: Copy a model with the ability to configure the following settings: - Set the copied versions to use the original source mappings. - Import hidden objects. - Apply model conversions.
